tool: built-in image_gen; no CLI/API key, asset purchase, web download or private-project upload

outputs.briefSummary: Magenta-haired young Squire; red/gold cuirass, silver shoulders, red/white skirt, brown boots; dark radial gold-rimmed round shield and sword. Painted proportions/textures guided by R2 Guard without copying Guard silhouette. Six-column five-action sheet: alert idle, alternating steps, anticipated diagonal sword cut/contact/recovery with body and shield participation, wound recoil, knees/side collapse. Fixed right-facing camera; transparent, no text.

Blue-armored teal-haired mounted Lancer, chestnut horse, black mane/tail, blue harness/barding, red saddle cloth, long brown/gold lance and silver tip; no shield. Coordinated horse/rider rather than enlarged infantry. Six-column five-action sheet: guarded idle, articulated diagonal trot, lower/contact/recover lance with stable saddle, wound recoil, horse knees/side fall with rider. Painted R2 material density; fixed right-facing camera, transparent, no text.

processing: prepare-batch-2.py extracts actual painted poses using alpha and fixed sheet cell/ground registration, one scale per unit; compiles atlas and SHA256 runtime names. Squire final two prone cells touch: split original connected pixels at source x1147, no synthetic pose. Originals retained. No card image replacement.
scope: Only main:monster:19 and main:monster:43. v3 references unchanged v2 map/UI/Guard images; other quality variants remain original.
directionBoundary: Right-facing painted view, entire actor mirrored around constant foot pivot for west; mirrored mount offset. No independently painted rear view or dynamic body-part attachment. Lance/attack remains enemy-facing; anatomical shield/sword screen side swaps for Squire as for R2 Guard.
approval: R2 direction accepted as production basis for these two candidates only. New Squire/Lancer visual quality still awaits user review; not whole-game originality or all-device acceptance.
